name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 26 – Am 69
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 26c. Rejects the continuation of the current ‘rule of law conditionality’ system and, moreover, the further strengthening and extending of conditionalities; recalls that any initiative on strengthening or extending conditionalities goes against simplification and competitiveness by making it more difficult and time-consuming for Member States to receive funding;
